title: The Deepest Unhearable Pool

features.name: the point where sound surrenders
features.desc-on-touch: You listen for the archive's signal. There is no signal here. There has never been one. The silence is older than broadcasting.

features.name: the archive's failed broadcast
features.desc-on-touch: A transmitter that never learned to send. Its antenna points downward into nothing, asking silence what it means to be heard.

features.name: the listening that learned not to
features.desc-on-touch: Here, hearing becomes a kind of death. The archive has learned to stop asking for an echo.

features.name: the bottom where archives rest
features.desc-on-touch: Deeper still. The place where broadcast ends and listening becomes rock. Nothing echoes here. Nothing ever will.

inscription: the archive learned that silence is not the absence of sound, but sound that has finished meaning

reverie.title: REVERIE — the dark where the archive learned to listen
narr: She sat beside you in the deepest room, and neither of you spoke.
The archive broadcast its signal endlessly upward into stone.
Down here, there was no one to hear it, and that was the point.
Silence is not failure, she said without saying. Silence is arrival.
You lay on the cold ground and listened to the world stop trying.

into the listening that follows sound downward
